descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de informații
We are looking for an experienced .NET Developer with strong software development skills and good French language proficiency to join our development team. You will be involved in designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality software solutions, collaborating with international teams and French-speaking stakeholders.
Responsibilities 
Design, develop, and maintain applications using .NET technologies.
Develop scalable and reliable backend solutions.
Build and integrate RESTful APIs and web services.
Work with relational databases and optimize queries.
Collaborate with frontend developers, architects, and business stakeholders.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical decisions.
Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve software issues.
Ensure code quality, performance, security, and maintainability.
Communicate effectively with French-speaking clients and stakeholders.
 Requirements 
Solid experience in software development using C# and .NET / .NET Core.
Good knowledge of ASP.NET Core and Web API.
Experience with SQL databases, preferably Microsoft SQL Server.
Understanding of REST APIs and microservices architecture.
Knowledge of object-oriented programming principles and design patterns.
Experience with Git and version control systems.
Familiarity with software testing and debugging.
Good command of French (B2/C1 level).
Good communication and teamwork skills.
English proficiency is an advantage.
 Nice to Have 
Experience with Entity Framework / Entity Framework Core.
Knowledge of Angular, React, or other frontend technologies.
Experience with Azure or other cloud platforms.
Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines.
